style: High-end 3D animated preschool cartoon style, soft rounded toy-like shapes, smooth matte clay-like materials, soft studio lighting with a warm key light, pastel but saturated colors, big expressive glossy eyes, cute and friendly, clean composition, high quality render.
lock: TITO, a baby elephant toddler. Powder-blue body, very big round ears with peach-pink insides, short soft trunk curled up at the tip, big glossy dark-brown eyes with white sparkle highlights, rosy cheeks, a tiny tuft of three hairs on top of the head, wearing small sunny-yellow overalls with one round red button, short chubby arms and legs, small tail.
title: Calcetines de colores
room: Interior of a bright cozy kids bedroom next to the playroom, vertical 9:16 composition, camera at child eye level. Light wooden floor, round pastel-pink rug, a small open wooden drawer on the floor, pairs of socks lying on the rug: two red socks, two blue socks, two yellow socks. Big window with soft daylight. The room is empty: no characters, no animals, no faces, no people.
lyrics:
[Intro]
¡Uy! ¡Calcetines!
¿Dónde está su par?
[Verse]
Rojo con rojo, ¡aquí está!
Azul con azul, ¡qué bien se ve!
[Chorus]
Calcetines de colores, ¡uno y dos!
Cada uno con su par, ¡qué bonito son!
[Bridge]
Azul con amarillo… ¿así? ¡No, no!
[Outro]
¡Amarillo con amarillo! ¡Tu-tuuu!
shots: A1
Medium shot: a pile of colorful socks falls on the baby elephant's head, a red sock hangs from his trunk, surprised face.
Socks tumble onto the baby elephant's head, he blinks and shakes his ears, a red sock dangling from his trunk. Static camera.
A2
Medium shot: the baby elephant sits on the rug looking at pairs of colorful socks, curious face, trunk pointing at them.
The baby elephant looks around at the socks and tilts his head curiously. Static camera.
A3
Medium close-up: the baby elephant holds two red socks together with his trunk and hand, happy smile.
The elephant joins the two red socks and holds them up proudly. Static camera.
A4
Medium close-up: the baby elephant holds two blue socks together, happy smile.
The elephant joins the two blue socks and waves them happily. Static camera.
A5
Wide shot: the baby elephant dances on the rug waving pairs of socks, ears flapping.
The elephant dances side to side waving the sock pairs, ears flapping on the beat. Slight camera sway.
A6
Medium shot: the baby elephant holds one blue sock and one yellow sock together, puzzled face, head tilted.
The elephant looks at the blue and yellow socks, tilts his head and blinks, puzzled. Slow push-in.
A7
Medium shot: the baby elephant holds two yellow socks together and raises his trunk happily.
The elephant swaps to two yellow socks, nods and raises his trunk with joy. Static camera.
A8
Wide shot: three sock pairs lined up neatly on the rug, red, blue and yellow, the baby elephant sits proudly next to them.
The elephant sits proudly by the neat sock pairs, then one sock slides off and he gasps. Static camera.
